decision_rationale: Primary model paper: it presents H2O as a new framework for bridging histopathology and spatial multi-omics. The abstract and full text explicitly describe ViT plus LLM contrastive alignment from H&E to spatial transcriptomics/proteomics.
evidence_snippet: “H2O integrates Vision Transformers (ViT) with Large Language Models (LLM) via contrastive learning” and “enabling the direct inference of spatial transcriptomics (ST) and proteomics (SP) landscapes from routine H&E images”
